## Product decision

- Promise advanced: Understand / Guide / Keep coherent
- Human or coding-agent decision improved:
- Existing AnaxiIndex evidence and product surface reused:

## Simplification

- Removed, merged, or replaced:
- Production-line delta:
- Default tools, commands, routes, tables, and dashboard destinations added/removed:
- Why no smaller change delivers the same outcome:

## Evidence

- Smallest end-to-end behavior proving the improvement:
- Facts, interpretations, and recommendations remain distinguishable:
- Focused tests and complete quality gate:
- User-facing explanation, empty/error states, and documentation checked:

If the change adds a product surface or grows production code, explain the demonstrated core defect,
why an existing path cannot solve it, and which equivalent concept will be retired. Security,
corruption, and correctness fixes may grow temporarily but still require a follow-up simplification
decision.
